measured_corrections_to_base_contract.finding: Deribit dropped every collector connection at ~61.4s across 7 measured cycles (set_heartbeat 30s acked 'ok'; one rpc_heartbeat at ~+30s per connection; NO test_request message was ever delivered before the drop). Deribit's documented expectation is that the CLIENT answers the server's heartbeat with a public/test request; the cng4-a3 collector only probed on silence and never answered, so the connection was server-terminated at the 60s mark.
measured_corrections_to_base_contract.correction: the collector now queues a public/test reply when a heartbeat or test_request message arrives (answers go out in the receive loop; the triggering messages are still captured verbatim; heartbeat_count semantics unchanged).
measured_corrections_to_base_contract.effect_on_floors: Removes a ~61s reconnect cycle that cost ~2.5s of stream per cycle to backoff+resubscribe; without it ~4% of wall-clock Deribit coverage was lost. Reconnect handling itself was contract-compliant (fresh snapshot per epoch, no cross-epoch stitching) — this correction removes the unnecessary reconnects.

measured_corrections_to_base_contract.finding: The cng4-a3 reading 'book feed: per (product_id, side) seq, consecutive increments expected' did NOT survive live-wire scale: with per-(product, side) keying the arrival-order delta histogram per key was 1,2,3,4,5,... (~30% of book messages flagged as false gaps; 30,825 gap records in the first ~135k-line shard). Merging both sides per product in arrival order gives delta==1 for 31007/31008 (PF_XBTUSD) and 15239/15240 (PF_ETHUSD) transitions: Kraken futures book seq is ONE counter per product_id SHARED across buy/sell sides.
measured_corrections_to_base_contract.correction: collector gap/dedupe key for kraken book = (venue, product_id, seq); gap iff per-product arrival-order delta > 1; book_snapshot resets continuity. Evidence: live shard kraken/2026/09/17/1789613372030.jsonl (first connection), analyzed pre-correction; the false-gap shard rows remain in the raw record (verbatim capture; the gap records are data and are NOT rewritten).
measured_corrections_to_base_contract.effect_on_floors: Removes a false-gap bias that would have invalidated a large fraction of derived H1 bars; makes the valid-triad floor honestly computable.
